no_changes_rationale:
Bead: FZ-039 — Rename GitHub repo metadata files
Audit result: no changes required

## What was audited

All files under .github/ at base-rev 94bceb7:

  .github/workflows/ci.yml
  .github/workflows/release.yml
  .github/workflows/website.yml

No CODEOWNERS, issue templates (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/), or PR templates
(.github/pull_request_template.md) exist in this repository.

## Findings per file

ci.yml
  No product-name references. Uses only standard GitHub Actions primitives and
  `make` targets. Clean.

release.yml
  Already uses the Fizeau binary name throughout:
    env.BINARY_NAME: fiz                   (line 10)
    go build … ./cmd/fiz                   (line 49)
  This file was updated by a prior rename bead (ddx-agent → fiz in release
  workflow). Clean.

website.yml
  Contains the variable MIN_AGENT_VERSION (lines 47, 50). This was inspected
  carefully:
  - The rename-noise checker rule for AGENT_* uses the regex
    \b(?:DDX_AGENT|AGENT)_[A-Z0-9_]+\b. The underscore before AGENT in
    MIN_AGENT_VERSION is a word character, so there is no word boundary before
    AGENT. The checker produces zero hits for this file (confirmed).
  - MIN_AGENT_VERSION is a local build variable that feeds the Makefile target
    `catalog-dist`, which passes --min-agent-version to cmd/catalogdist. The
    Go flag, struct field (MinAgentVersion), and JSON key (min_agent_version)
    all live in catalogdist/ and cmd/catalogdist/. Renaming only the workflow
    variable without renaming that downstream stack would be inconsistent.
  - Renaming the full catalogdist API (--min-agent-version flag, JSON field
    min_agent_version) is a separate concern outside .github metadata scope and
    requires its own bead.
  - Allowlisted: local build variable mapping to the catalogdist API field;
    not an exported Fizeau product env var of the form AGENT_* or DDX_AGENT_*.

## Acceptance criteria verdict

"All active .github metadata uses Fizeau/fiz or is allowlisted with reason."

  - release.yml: uses fiz ✓
  - ci.yml: no product naming ✓
  - website.yml: MIN_AGENT_VERSION allowlisted above ✓
  - CODEOWNERS: does not exist, nothing to rename ✓
  - issue/PR templates: do not exist, nothing to rename ✓

AC is satisfied. No code changes are needed for this bead.

## What a follow-up attempt would need

If a future bead wants to complete the catalogdist rename, it should:
  1. Rename --min-agent-version flag in cmd/catalogdist/main.go
  2. Rename MinAgentVersion field in catalogdist/catalogdist.go (Go struct + JSON tag)
  3. Rename the corresponding Makefile variable and flag reference
  4. Update website.yml env var from MIN_AGENT_VERSION to MIN_FIZEAU_VERSION
  5. Update any catalog consumers that parse the min_agent_version JSON key
